channel.title: Hockey Network USA
channel.description: Independent Utah hockey coverage: Utah Mammoth weekly reports and schedule, plus youth and adult leagues, ice rinks and learn-to-skate programs across the state.

item.title: Before the Mammoth: Utah's hockey story, from the Salt Palace to now
item.description: The Golden Eagles, the Grizzlies, the 2002 Olympics. A look back at the decades of hockey that got Utah ready for the NHL.

item.title: Youth hockey in Utah: how to get your kid started
item.description: Free try-it days, age groups, rec versus travel, rough costs, and what to ask a program before you sign up.

item.title: Utah Mammoth 2026-27 season guide
item.description: Year three of NHL hockey in Salt Lake City. The 84-game schedule, the dates worth circling, tickets, and how to make a night of it at Delta Center.

item.title: Utah Mammoth weekly report: week of November 2, 2026
item.description: A tough week for the Mammoth: 1-2-0 from Oct 26 to Nov 1, with opponents scoring 12 to our 8. Results, this week's schedule and the Central standings.

item.title: Beginner hockey gear checklist (and how to save on it)
item.description: Every piece of gear a new player needs, what to buy new, what's fine used, and how to find skates that fit.

item.title: Utah's ice time crunch: Acord closure and what it means for skaters
item.description: Acord Ice Center is closed for repairs and Salt Lake County changed its public skate rules. What happened, and where to skate in the meantime.

item.title: Adult rec hockey in Utah: a beginner's guide
item.description: It's not too late. How grown-ups go from public skate to stick-and-puck, drop-in and their first beer league game.

item.title: Winter Classic in Salt Lake City: a fan's guide
item.description: Utah hosts Colorado at Rice-Eccles Stadium on New Year's Eve 2026. What to wear, how to get there, and why outdoor hockey hits so close to home.

item.title: How to learn to skate in Utah, for kids and adults
item.description: Where to find lessons, how to beat the waitlists, what to wear, and what those wobbly first sessions are really like.
